title: DashboardPortfolio
wrapsNative: ScrollView with a VStack: a horizontal ScrollView of MonarchStatCard, MonarchInsightStrip, and MonarchDashboardGrid of MonarchWidget sections holding MonarchDonutChart (Swift Charts SectorMark), MonarchBarList, MonarchLeaderboard and MonarchActivityTimeline; .navigationTitle and .toolbar for the header
summary: A recipe, not a component: the home screen of a portfolio product (assets, contracts, intellectual property) with what the portfolio is made of, what needs attention, what comes up, a breakdown, the largest items and recent activity.
whenToUse: As the Home tab of a product that manages a portfolio of things with value, owners and renewal dates.
whenNotToUse: For a person's own tasks and schedule use the dashboard-personal-work recipe. For a single chart use MonarchDonutChart or MonarchBarList on their own.
api: ScrollView { VStack { ScrollView(.horizontal) { HStack { MonarchStatCard(…) } }; MonarchInsightStrip(_:insights:); MonarchDashboardGrid(_:layout:itemLabel:span:isEditing:content:) { MonarchWidget(_:systemImage:variant:onViewAll:content:) } } }

Sections: Composition (MonarchDonutChart), Needs attention and Coming up (rows with MonarchBadge), Breakdown (MonarchBarList), Top items (MonarchLeaderboard), Recent activity (MonarchActivityTimeline with density .compact)
.navigationTitle("Portfolio") and .toolbar { Menu or Picker with .pickerStyle(.menu) for the period and actions }

states.name: home
states.description: Key figures that scroll sideways, insights, then one column of widgets on phones (two or three on iPad).

states.name: arranging
states.description: isEditing on MonarchDashboardGrid lets people move widgets; the order is stored in layout.

states.name: loading and errors
states.description: Charts take status, lists isLoading, widgets state .loading, .empty(…) or .failed(…) with onRetry.

states.name: section left out
states.description: Every section is optional: leave its tile out of the grid.

appearance: The theme's canvas with Monarch widget cards; the donut uses the data colour roles, bars and leaderboards the accent, badges their tones. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web DashboardPortfolio is one template component with named slots and a two-column activity section. On iOS it is a recipe in a NavigationStack: the title and period live in the navigation bar and toolbar, and the sections are MonarchWidget in MonarchDashboardGrid, one column on phones, so each chart gets the full width. The KPI row is a horizontal ScrollView of MonarchStatCard. The web's ranking slot (Leaderboard) is MonarchLeaderboard; the web's hrefs become onViewAll and onSelect callbacks that push detail screens. The web's messages are the app's own strings here. Android composes the same recipe.
accessibility: The title is a header; each widget title is a header.
The donut chart has a summary and a table toggle, so the composition is not told by colour alone (MonarchDonutChart).
Attention and renewal rows are one element each with a word badge, not only a colour.
The grid is a container named "Dashboard" with Move earlier and Move later in arrange mode (MonarchDashboardGrid).
Every control is at least 44 points.
edgeCases: Compact currency (isCompact) keeps large values on one line in stat cards.
The grid does not scroll: keep it inside the screen's ScrollView.
Store layout per person so the arrangement survives launches.
